_meta._doc: ollie · english strings · literal voice (accessibility). idiom and metaphor stripped. used when settings.literal_voice = true. every key in strings.en.json must exist here.

intro.title: Welcome.
intro.body: Ollie organizes what you write into the right modules. There are 7 setup questions. You can skip any of them.
intro.placeholder: What name should I use for you?

age.title: What is your age range?
age.sub: This helps adjust some defaults. You can skip this question.

country.title: What country do you live in?
country.sub: If you have a mental health crisis, I will show the local hotline number.

locale.title: Which language do you prefer?
locale.sub: English or Turkish. You can change this later in settings.

menstr.title: Do you track a menstrual cycle?
menstr.sub: If you select 'No', the cycle module will not appear in the app.

goals.title: What topics interest you most?
goals.sub: Select as many as you want. You can change this later.

confirm.body: Type whatever you want into the box below. Ollie will sort it into the correct module. If you write about a mental health crisis, Ollie will show a hotline number instead of analyzing the text.

consent.title: Module permissions.
consent.sub: Select the modules you want to use.

home.headline: What is on your mind?
home.hint: Type to begin. Press ${0} to see commands.

confirmation.grocery_running_low: Your toilet paper is running low. Added to shopping list.
confirmation.finance_bill_upcoming: Your ${0} bill is due in ${1} days.
confirmation.pets_fed: Logged: ${0} was fed. Last feeding was ${1} hours ago.
confirmation.sleep_logged: Logged ${0} hours ${1} minutes of sleep for last night.
confirmation.fallback_no_match: I could not match this to a module. Saved as a journal entry.

empty.cycle_cold: Enter the start date of your last period. Approximate is fine.
empty.sleep_cold: Log a few more nights. Patterns will appear after about 14 nights.
empty.journal_none: No journal entries yet. Type to begin.
empty.focus_idle: What task are you working on?
empty.astrology_no_birth: Enter your birth date, time, and location.

cta.cycle: Log your last period to begin.

insist.pet_water_low: ${0} water bottle low. ${1} hours since last refill.

fire.passport_expiring: ${0} expires tomorrow. Last day to renew.

crisis.opener_with_name: ${0}, this seems difficult. You are not alone.
crisis.opener_no_name: This seems difficult. You are not alone.
crisis.hotline_line: ${0} (${1}), available 24 hours a day, every day.
crisis.close: You can return to the journal when ready.

work.b2: Deadlines that are abstract until close.
work.b3: Task-switching cost, hyperfocus crash, post-meeting fatigue.
work.b4: Log: tasks, focus minutes, completed items.

habits.b1: Daily check-ins. No streaks, no chains.
habits.b2: Drift detection — habits that quietly stopped.
habits.b3: Luteal phase collapse, sensory load, friction patterns.
habits.b4: Log: check the row when you complete a habit.
habits.b5: Patterns appear after about 2 weeks of data.

goals.b1: One goal at a time. Why it matters. Target date.
goals.b2: Archive of goals you chose to stop.
goals.b4: Log: a goal, an obstacle, a session tag.
goals.b5: Maximum 5 active goals. More than that dilutes attention.

finance.b1: Impulse spending after a hard day.
finance.b2: Subscriptions you forgot are still active.
finance.b4: Log: a recurring bill or a recent purchase.
finance.b5: No bank connection. You tell Ollie what to track.

admin.b1: Avoidance of phone calls. Missing renewal dates.
admin.b2: Paperwork that needs breaking into steps.
admin.b3: The last 5% — finishing what you already started.
admin.b4: Log: a task, even a small one.
admin.b5: Cost of delay appears when a task gets old.

cycle.b1: Cycle day, phase, predicted next period as a range.
cycle.b2: Health flags that cite a clinical source. Not diagnostic.
cycle.b3: Fertility information only if you opt in.
cycle.b4: Log: first day of bleeding, cramps, mood, fatigue.
cycle.b5: Patterns appear after 3 or more cycles.

sleep.b1: Bedtime, wake time, cumulative sleep debt.
sleep.b2: How sleep loss affects mood and focus the next day.
sleep.b4: Log: when you went to bed and when you woke up.
sleep.b5: No sleep score. Raw clock data only.

body.b3: Hydration and headaches, movement and cognitive state.
body.b4: Log: a glass of water, a supplement, a walk.

pets.b1: Feeding, vet appointments, and supplies for each pet.
pets.b3: Delayed vet appointments, schedule lapses under stress.
pets.b4: Log: add a pet, mark a feeding, log a vet visit.
pets.b5: Reminders pause when you mark yourself as away.

dump.b1: Write any thought here. Ollie sorts it.
dump.b2: Sentinel sorts entries: log, route, or ignore.
dump.b3: Useful for capturing thoughts before working memory loses them.
dump.b4: Log: type anything. One line or a paragraph.
dump.b5: Review mode lets you check before Ollie commits.

grocery.b1: What is in your pantry, shown by fill level.
grocery.b2: Critical, watching, and stocked categories. Predicted run-out.
grocery.b3: Shopping mode for the store. Recipes from what you have.
grocery.b4: Log: type groceries — milk, eggs, paper towels.
grocery.b5: No streaks. No rewards. Just fill levels.

astrology.b4: Log: your birth time and location once.

adherence.body: Your last cycle was ${0} days, which is unusually long. Did you miss logging a period, or was it actually that long?

irregular.copy: Cycle pattern is variable. No useful phase estimate this month.

day.empty_sub: No period logged yet. Use the record section below to start.

next.need_logged: Log a period to get a prediction.

confidence.cold: First prediction — based on typical cycle length.
confidence.variable: Variable pattern — this is a rough estimate only.
confidence.shifting: Pattern changed recently — using last 6 cycles.

pattern.body: ${0} has clustered in your ${1} phase across ${2} cycles. This is a pattern, not a medical conclusion.

fertile.detail: This is a range, not a specific day.

fertility.label: Tracking for fertility
fertility.sub: Shows fertile window estimate when enabled.

passphrase.label: Backup passphrase hint
passphrase.sub: A hint to help you remember your .void file password.
